crop.notes: Whole 'Sporting Notes' column; only the second paragraph is the Allen notice. Other items: Dupont Park bird shoot, Maroons baseball, Kid McCoy/Tommy Ryan offer, swimming championship, Kerwin vs. Everhart.

ocr.notes: Allen notice garbled; OCR reads '610 Market' and 'ree tions', image clearly reads '619 Market street. Free concert every evening.'

title.suggested: Tom Allen's Free Concerts at 619 Market Street

summary.suggested: The St. Louis Globe-Democrat carried a notice that Tom Allen, retired champion pugilist of the world, offered a free concert every evening at 619 Market Street, with only the best singers engaged.

metadata.notes: Masthead: St. Louis Daily Globe-Democrat, Saturday Morning, August 20, 1898, page 7. Current summary has the wrong address (610); image reads 619.

facts.fact: Allen's place at 619 Market Street, St. Louis, offered free concerts every evening; he was billed as retired champion pugilist of the world
